title: Treaty of Breda (1650)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Breda (1650)", at revision 1352370515, opens: "The Treaty of Breda (1650) was signed on 1 May 1650 between Charles II, exiled king of England, Scotland and Ireland, and the Scottish Covenanter government. Under its terms, they agreed to install Charles II as King of England as well as Scotland, while Charles undertook to establish a Presbyterian form for the Church of England, and guarantee the rights of the Church of Scotland." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2374127, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1650 treaty between Charles II and Scottish Covenanters". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
